audit_expectations.mode: Local business (thin but correct — precision test)
audit_expectations.notes: A small, three-page local bakery: valid LocalBusiness schema, address, hours, phone, prices in text, consistent nav. It has no blog, few web mentions, and no reviews. A correct auditor must NOT invent freshness, corroboration, or entity-ambiguity findings just because a small business has a light footprint.
